summary: the case of tests/run menu under etude, against a bootctl cancel that leaves next_entry empty instead of removing it, a bootctl config that writes half the menu into the slot, and a stub whose fallback entry has another title

argv: sh tests/proofs/guest.sh make utils && sh tests/proofs/guest.sh copy ${WORK} utils/sbin/bootctl && cp tools/image/mkdisk_grub.sh ${WORK}/

faults.name: cancel-empties
faults.summary: bootctl cancel writes an empty next_entry, the marker a trial boot leaves, instead of removing the key

faults.name: half-menu
faults.summary: bootctl config writes the first half of the menu, its first entry, and pads the rest of the slot, so the second entry is lost

faults.name: fallback-title
faults.summary: the stub's fallback entry, entry 1, has a title that is not the one its number stands for

edits.find: menuentry "Start Rach2 with the previous kernel" --id fallback {
edits.replace: menuentry "Start Rach2 with the prior kernel" --id fallback {
